propositions: Plans make capability-surface assertions about named modules (e.g., module M provides/lacks capability C) that are refuted by actual code, leading agents to build on nonexistent capabilities or rebuild existing ones
The existing E4 existence check passes when a named module exists but misses finer-grained capability-surface mismatches (specific capability absent when present, or present when plan says absent)

A new advisory, code-grounded, agent-tier criterion 'asserted-capability' must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM, CODEBASE_GROUNDED, AGENT_TIER with default_posture='advisory' and exec='AGENT', and routed with a rubric prompt and guide section

The criterion must fire on all three E1-verified misses (dc58, db7b, 5886 reconstructed to their original false-asserting plan text) and must not block on clean plans or false-fires (advisory posture only)

Registration, deterministic unit tests, and a committed bounded sanity-check eval fixture set with result artifact must validate the criterion's recall >=0.66 over misses and auto-integration with the standing effectiveness recorder
